response.original_title: Moner sathe judhdho ( মনের সাথে যুদ্ধ )
response.overview: Moner Sathe Juddho revolves around the internal and external conflicts of a courageous protagonist (played by Manna) who finds himself caught between his personal values, duty, and emotional ties. Living in a society fraught with crime, corruption, and injustice, he takes a stand against villainous forces (played by Nasir Khan and others). Along the way, his life is complicated by his deep romantic involvement with his love interest (played by Purnima) and dynamic brotherhood ties (played by Bapparaj). As circumstances force him to wage a war not only against external enemies but also within his own heart ("Moner Sathe Juddho"), he undergoes severe sacrifices to uphold truth, protect his family, and bring justice to the oppressed.
